Name: Tsum Tsum Script - ALPHA
Message:
**Changes**
1. Coronation Day Elsa skill added: her window freezes as much of the board as it can, then sets the whole pile off in one burst. Elsa reads "Skill Level" as how long her freeze window stays open, 5 seconds at level 1 up to 10 at level 6, and ignores your "Max chain" and "Chains per board scan" settings.
2. Rapunzel+ skill added: her skill draws one chain through tsums of any colour, as long as "Skill Level" allows — 9 tsums at level 1 up to 24 at level 6, ignoring your "Max chain" setting during the skill.
3. "Delay between rounds" setting added: rest a set number of minutes after each round. The Quick Bar counts the rest down and starts the next round on a tap, and the rest can be changed mid-run. Hearts and the mailbox carry on during it.

_USE WITH CAUTION_
